```{r}

fix_mojibake <- function(x) {
  if (!is.character(x)) return(x)
  
  y <- iconv(x, from = "UTF-8", to = "latin1", sub = "byte")
  # y contient maintenant les octets originaux (ceux du fichier source)
  # on les redéclare comme UTF-8 au lieu de les reconvertir
  Encoding(y) <- "UTF-8"
  
  # sécurité : si la conversion a produit NA sur des valeurs non-NA
  # (chaîne pas réellement mal encodée), on garde l'original
  ifelse(is.na(y) & !is.na(x), x, y)
}

df_pop2100_65plus <- read.csv(text = getURL("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MathieuScheffer/Projet-Hackaton/Resources/df_pop2100_65plus.csv"))
df_pop2100_65plus$projection <- fix_mojibake(df_pop2100_65plus$projection)

df_pop2100_65plus <- df_pop2100_65plus %>%
  mutate(
    projection = recode(
      projection,
      "Historique"       = "Historical",
      "Ligne de base"    = "Baseline",
      "Forte migration"  = "High migration",
      "Faible fertilité" = "Low fertility",
      "Faible migration" = "Low migration",
      "Forte fertilité"  = "High fertility"
    )
  )

highchart() %>%
  hc_chart(type = "line") %>%

  hc_xAxis(
    plotLines = list(
      list(
        color = "#000000",
        width = 2,
        value = 2024,
        dashstyle = "Dash",
        label = list(
          text = "End of historical data",
          verticalAlign = "top",
          textAlign = "left"
        )
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  
  hc_yAxis(
    title = list(
      text = "Number of people"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  hc_tooltip(
    shared = TRUE,
    crosshairs = TRUE,
    valueDecimals = 0
  ) %>%
  
  hc_add_series_list(
    df_pop2100_65plus %>%
      group_split(projection) %>%
      map(
        ~ list(
          name = unique(.x$projection),
          data = list_parse2(
            .x %>%
              dplyr::select(
                x = year,
                y = population
              )
          ),
          dashStyle = ifelse(
            unique(.x$projection) == "Historical",
            "Solid",
            "Dash"
          )
        )
      )
  ) %>%
  
  hc_plotOptions(
    series = list(
      marker = list(
        enabled = FALSE
      )
    )
  )

```
